title: Roost Rise (Hawkeye Flew By)
style: drift phonk meets cinematic trap, 130 bpm, slowed cowbell, dark 808 sub, helicopter rotor texture on the breakdown, distorted brass stab, watchful sentinel mood, deterministic kick on the perimeter sweep, eagle-cry sample on the chorus, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the bass, alert but composed
lyrics:
[Intro — helicopter rotors fade in]
Roost rise. Eyes up. Perimeter clean.
Hawkeye flew by, the field is seen.

[Verse 1]
First light on the ridge, the watcher takes the post
Nothing moves on the wire that the watcher hasn't crossed
Four cardinal directions, four corners of the keep
The roost rises early, the roost does not sleep

[Pre-Drop]
Radar on the rotor, signal on the wing
Three-three-six in the carrier, the alert can sing

[Drop]
Roost rise — Hawkeye flew by
Eyes on the field, eyes on the sky
Roost rise — the perimeter holds
Three-three-six in the watch, the story unfolds

[Verse 2]
The sentinel is calm, the sentinel is awake
What the sentinel sees, the system can take
No false alarm, no sleeping at the wheel
Just the steady eye on the iron and the steel

[Drop]
Roost rise — Hawkeye flew by
Eyes on the field, eyes on the sky
Roost rise — the perimeter holds
Three-three-six in the watch, the story unfolds

[Outro]
First light. Last light. Same eye.
Roost rise. Hawkeye flew by.
